design.question: Does lagged industry momentum improve portfolio selection after turnover and modelled trading costs?
design.universe: French Data Library 49 value-weighted US industry research portfolios
design.signal: Compound industry returns from holding month t-12 through t-2 inclusive; skip t-1
design.eligibility: All 11 signal observations plus prior month return must be present; never use holding-month return to choose eligibility
design.buffer_rule: Retain previous holdings ranked 15 or better, then fill to ten from the highest remaining ranks; equal target weights
design.constraints: Long only, fully invested, no leverage; ten 10% target weights for signal portfolios; equal target weights across eligible industries for benchmark
design.cost_basis: One-way charge on each dollar bought or sold; solve the cost-funded rebalance exactly and charge initial entry
design.turnover_definition: One-way turnover is max(buys, sales) divided by pre-trade wealth; cash-funded entry is included
design.selection_rule: Choose the momentum policy with the higher net information ratio versus equal industries during validation at 10 bp; ties choose Top 10 momentum
design.test_policy: Freeze the selection before calculating final-block performance; do not redesign after seeing the test

nearby_parameters.purpose: Final robustness diagnostics only; do not use to replace the selected policy

design.inference: Newey-West mean/OLS standard errors with six monthly lags; intervals are conditional on this single-vintage dataset and fixed design
design.benchmark: Monthly equal allocation across eligible industries, with the same cost convention
design.liquidation: No terminal liquidation; final value marks the continuing portfolio
design.block_initialisation: Each development, validation and final test block starts in cash, charges entry, and warms the signal from earlier observations.

selection.selection_rule: Choose the momentum policy with the higher net information ratio versus equal industries during validation at 10 bp; ties choose Top 10 momentum
